hotel.name: Sheraton Guadalajara Expo
hotel.amenities: Fitness center; Pool; Restaurant; Bar; Room service; Breakfast available (fee); Meeting event space; Wedding services; Free high-speed internet; Coffee/tea in-room
hotel.hotelDescription: Experience the epitome of modern elegance and unparalleled service at The Sheraton Guadalajara Expo Hotel, nestled in the vibrant heart of La Perla Tapatia, Guadalajara City. Conveniently positioned minutes from Plaza del Sol Mall and the Expo Guadalajara, one of Mexico's foremost convention centers. Step into our newly designed rooms and suites, thoughtfully appointed with complimentary Wi-Fi and prompt room service. To elevate the experience, Marriott Bonvoy Platinum, Titanium, and Ambassador members have exclusive access to our Sheraton Lounge, where they will find refined amenities and personalized service. Indulge in relaxation at QUIDEA Spa or savor exquisite culinary delights at La Prieta restaurant, which promises a unique dining experience. Look no further than our versatile event spaces, which encompass over 400 square meters of sophisticated venues. We offer impeccable catering services and event planning assistance.
